Subject: Update on the Conference Call in respect of the Company’s Q1 & FY27       
                results.  
 
Dear Sirs/Madam, 
 
In furtherance of our letter dated 10 July 2026, informing the Exchanges regarding 
conference call in respect of the Company’s Q1 & FY27 results, we wish to inform that 
the said conference call was held on 21 July 2026 at 06:00 p.m. IST. 
 
The audio recording of the conference call has been hosted on the website of the 
Company and is available at ‘QUARTERLY RESULTS’ drop down available at 
https://www.bajajauto.com/investors/financial-and-operational-performance  
 
 
Kindly take this on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully,  
For Bajaj Auto Limited 
 
 
 
Rajiv Gandhi
